content.primaryPurpose: Improve complete common-harness consumer quality using existing owners and evidence.

existingMethodologyBasis.wiki: Existing SharedWiki AIP Evolve/Evals source captures
existingMethodologyBasis.role: Dated local transfer of Target/Goal/Validation/Allowed changes/Limits/Decision, not new Palantir runtime integration

locations.stage: Original purpose, interview and current contract
locations.canonicalOwner: work-continuity; existing Project/Work and original-source owners
locations.proposedApplication: Bind the useful target, relevant actual answers/reasons and independent quality criteria before candidate outputs. Reuse settled answers; record meaningful changes without resetting unrelated work.
locations.qualityEvidence: Correct original answer/selection context, current/historical contract relation and real criterion-source-before-behavior evidence.

locations.stage: Task dependencies, delegation and result recovery
locations.canonicalOwner: Git Work semantics plus existing native Codex/Hermes invocation and stores
locations.proposedApplication: Freeze necessary context/exposure and expected consumer outcome; integrate late-discovered owner/ID/logic dependencies as scoped successors, preserving independent valid work and durable result identity.
locations.qualityEvidence: Exact producer/occurrence/payload/receiver joins, actual useful result and no task/native ID substitution.

locations.stage: Common implementation and independent quality evaluation
locations.canonicalOwner: evidence-foundry eval semantics with existing canonical capability owners
locations.proposedApplication: Reuse Evaluation/VerificationUnit/CaseResult and extend only the agreed comparison meaning for criterion-level quality transitions. Independent oracles assess the same pinned outputs rather than launching native work per grader.
locations.qualityEvidence: Same-case violated-to-satisfied gains, satisfied-to-satisfied preservation, explicit regressions/unknowns and actual public producer/consumer compatibility.
locations.currentGap: Existing v1 compareImprovement requires both arms' required criteria pass and a scalar mean gain; it does not implement quality-first v2.

locations.stage: Git branch/worktree integration, CI and review
locations.canonicalOwner: Existing common/consumer CI and native Git/GitHub policy owners; CI Agent remains a proposed participant
locations.proposedApplication: Evaluate intended exact head/tree, source/semantic transitions, review provenance/current findings and consumer results; distinguish evidence not yet available from source failures. Use recent repeated CI mistakes as one cross-cutting scenario family. Explicitly cover complete publication, concurrent/lost-update prevention and original/history preservation for the whole common harness using existing Git mechanisms; retain only actual native-owner residuals.
locations.qualityEvidence: True positive/negative integration outcomes, correct source identity, no stale PASS, appropriate bounded recovery and no automatic merge.
locations.scope: Additional sub-scope; never the whole improvement purpose.
locations.newEvidence: Bounded45run research found18 independent main-push proof/readiness ordering incidents among19mainruns, plus distinct source-contract/fixture/consumer-dependency failures. Final green is not full incident history.

locations.stage: Native adoption and useful consumer operation
locations.proposedApplication: Keep source verification, installation, configured exposure, actual consumption and useful task outcome distinct. Scope a new observation only when genuinely needed and admitted.
locations.qualityEvidence: Actual consumer outcome and source/selected Work/currentness correlation; source-qualified output alone does not prove native task success.

locations.stage: Interruption, recovery, feedback and next decision
locations.canonicalOwner: work-continuity algorithms and retained native/original/evidence owners
locations.proposedApplication: Compare preserved purpose, next safe action, result custody and non-replay behavior after interruption. Reconcile new feedback once at the relevant Lead/Task boundary.
locations.qualityEvidence: Useful continuation, no duplicate completed/uncertain effect, preserved originals/history and explicit unresolved uncertainty.

commonConstraints: No second runtime, scheduler, connector client, credential bridge, native session mirror or evaluator registry.
No copied per-instance semantic policy into common core; no second schema generator.
No optimization prerequisite that prevents independent useful work without an actual dependency.
No native evaluation budget, publication, commit or activation is granted by this design map.
content.interviewDisposition: Choose the smallest justified changes only after concrete quality criteria and affected consumer paths are settled.
